_comment: BLANK ELA fill-in-the-blank template. Validates against curriculum_normalization.ela.schema.json once the <...> placeholders are replaced. REQUIRED fields (schema will reject the record without them): resource_id, title, provenance.{program,grade,subject}, placement.resource_type, domain.primary, objective, what_is_taught[>=1] (each item is an object {skill, cognitive_demand} with optional emphasis), student_actions (all 9 + domain_specific), evidence[>=1] (each item needs quote, location, actor, evidence_role, support, supports_action), teacher_actions.with_prompting_and_support, subject_profile.mode (and subject_profile.genre when domain.primary is Writing or Comprehension; and subject_profile.text_complexity{quantitative,qualitative} when domain.primary is Comprehension). Use tokens NONE OBSERVED / NONE / n/a / null / "" / [] / {} exactly as in the field guide.
title: <title as printed in source>

provenance.jurisdiction: <state/authority to score against, e.g. Georgia, or empty string>
provenance.subject: ELA/Literacy

objective: <one sentence, framework-neutral — the resource's own goal, NOT a standards claim>

supports_action: <student_actions key this quote proves; [] for teacher_model/teacher_scribe>

context.mode: <in isolation|in context|within full texts|oral discussion of images>

subject_profile.genre: <narrative|expository|opinion|poetic|mixed|n/a — REQUIRED when domain.primary is Writing or Comprehension>

text_complexity.quantitative: <Lexile/measure + grade band, e.g. '450L (grade 2-3 band)', or 'not measured' — REQUIRED block when domain.primary is Comprehension; delete this whole text_complexity object otherwise>
text_complexity.qualitative: <structure, language, knowledge demands, levels of meaning>
